about: The collect of the Fourth Sunday of Advent. It asks for haste, that grace outrun the sins standing in its way.

seg.tr: Stir up Your power, O Lord, we pray, and come; help us with great might, so that through the aid of Your grace Your merciful forgiveness may hasten what our sins delay. You live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

nt.w037: Deus can be nominative or vocative here: it can describe the One who lives and reigns as God, or address Him as “O God.” Both readings refer to Christ, whom the prayer addresses.
